{{Quests and Events|Xingyuan}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Xingyuan:''' [[Norfall Barrens]] is now under threats...
:'''Xingyuan:''' [[Tacet Discord]]s kept attacking, and it was only through the desperate resistance of the [[Midnight Rangers]] that [[Camp Overwatch]] was defended...
:'''Xingyuan:''' Although I've often read about the horrors of war in books. Seeing it with my own eyes is a whole different experience...
:'''Xingyuan:''' Even my heart feels like it's been drenched by the [[Retroact Rain]], losing its color just like the view of [[Withering Frontline]]...
:{{DIcon}} Spirits up.
:'''Xingyuan:''' *Sigh* Thank you. I should gather myself up.
:'''Xingyuan:''' Even though I can't join the Midnight Rangers on the front lines, there's still something I can do.
:'''Xingyuan:''' I want to capture the moment of where the desperate resistance shines upon those nameless graves.
{{Dialogue End}}
